reason: My first question is always whether it's really tested, and here the lab is named and the report for the batch is right on the page. $24.99 is low enough that I'd try one box off a video, and the empty-box refund means I'm not stuck with another half-used bottle.
objection: I already have a drawer of half-used bottles, so I might just not finish the 30 days. And I can't tell yet if the lab report is real until I open it.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR code or the product page report did not match the batch number, or the lab turned out to be unnamed or fake, I would not buy.
